newsitem.title: USA: Campbell to buy Grand Metropolitan unit.
newsitem.headline: Campbell to buy Grand Metropolitan unit.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said on Thursday it had reached agreement to purchase Germany's Erasco Group of Cos from Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc for about $210 million.
The company said in a statement the acquisition was "a strong move to grow its core businesses outside the United States."

Erasco is Germany's leading manufacturer and marketer of canned soup and hearty stew products under the "Erasco", "Gewiko", "Jokisch" and "Jurgen Langbein" brands. Erasco also is a leading marketer of shelf-stable ready meal brands throughout Germany.
It has yearly sales of about $223 million. Erasco has about 900 employees throughout Germany and manufacturing facilities in Lubeck, Preetz, Magdeburg and Kaltenkirchen.

Marty Thrasher, president of Campbell's International Grocery division, said, "Germans eat six times more soup per capita than U.S. consumers. Beyond Erasco's leading market position, we see significant opportunity to grow Germany's approximately $1 billion commercial soup category."
Financial details were not immediately available.
